what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: maximised logLik of the nb2_exposure fit
cases.note: nbinom2 one-axis latent fit, p = 6, n = 150 (sha256 checked), R: + offset(log(e)), converged with a positive-definite Hessian; same optimum (logLik within 1e-6, asserted in the test). Dispersion is per trait on both sides. Scope: every trait is one count family (the batch case mixed three count families on three rows, which Julia has no fit for), so this exercises a non-Poisson count family accepting a nonzero offset, not a family mix.
